name: CPW Virginia Tag Team Championship
epitaph: CPW's only attested title change: won in a three-way on the fed's own surviving show and still listed as held the very next day in the fed's own Update.

name: CPW East Coast Championship
epitaph: Listed vacant in the fed's own 14 October 1997 Update, with no reign attested anywhere in this wave's corpus.
notes: Reign start listed by the fed's own Update as "9/21/97 - Today," i.e. vacant since the title's own creation.

name: CPW Appalachian Valley Championship
epitaph: Listed vacant in the same Update, alongside the East Coast belt.

name: CPW Television Championship
epitaph: Listed vacant in the same Update, the third of CPW's three unclaimed singles belts.
